name: pleiades-fleet
description: Multi-personality Discord bot framework on TypeScript, discord.js and MongoDB, with a layered plugin architecture and bilingual i18n.

scripts.lint: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec eslint src scripts test tools eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest.projects.ts
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec eslint src scripts test tools --fix
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:int: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec vitest run --project integration --project integration-nodb
scripts.test:contract: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec vitest run --project contract
scripts.test:i18n: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec vitest run --project i18n
scripts.test:tools: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec vitest run --project tools
scripts.deploy: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec ts-node scripts/deploy.ts deploy
scripts.deploy:prepare: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec ts-node scripts/deploy.ts prepare
scripts.undeploy: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec ts-node scripts/deploy.ts undeploy
scripts.mongo:prepare: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec ts-node scripts/deploy.ts mongo-prepare
scripts.mongo:deploy: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec ts-node scripts/deploy.ts mongo-deploy
scripts.mongo:undeploy: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec ts-node scripts/deploy.ts mongo-undeploy
scripts.deploy:recover: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec ts-node scripts/deploy.ts recover
scripts.backup:install: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec node tools/mongo-backup/install.mjs install
scripts.backup:uninstall: node scripts/runtime.mjs exec node tools/mongo-backup/install.mjs uninstall

author: ACaccel, rbt4168
